# Pulse Hospital & I.C.U, Modasa

> Pulse Hospital & I.C.U (પલ્સ હોસ્પિટલ એન્ડ આઈ.સી.યુ.) is a leading 24x7 multi-specialty critical care hospital located at City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Arvalli district, Gujarat, India. It provides advanced ventilator ICU care, in-house spiral CT scanning, round-the-clock hemodialysis, and modular operation theatres led by senior MD physicians and critical care specialists.

## Core Hospital Details
- **Official Name**: Pulse Hospital & I.C.U
- **Gujarati Name**: પલ્સ હોસ્પિટલ એન્ડ આઈ.સી.યુ.
- **Tagline**: Caring For Life (જીવનની સંભાળ, આપણો વિશ્વાસ)
- **Address**: 4th Floor, A-Block, City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Arvalli - 383315, Gujarat, India
- **Emergency Helpline & OPD Desk**: +91 95120 45641 / +91 95120 45642
- **WhatsApp Appointment Booking**: +91 95120 45641 (https://wa.me/919512045641)
- **Emergency & ICU Operations**: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
- **Regular OPD Consultation Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 AM – 01:30 PM & 04:30 PM – 08:00 PM
- **Official Website**: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/

## Key Facilities & Medical Infrastructure
- **30+ Bed Intensive Care Unit (ICU)**: Multi-parameter hemodynamic monitors, invasive and non-invasive mechanical ventilators, central oxygen, arterial line blood pressure monitoring, isolation cubicle for immunocompromised patients.
- **In-House High-Speed CT Scan**: Available round-the-clock for stroke assessment within golden hour, polytrauma, abdominal pain, and thoracic emergencies.
- **24x7 Hemodialysis Unit**: Modern dialysis machines with automated bicarbonate delivery, dedicated reverse osmosis (RO) ultra-pure water plant, and isolated station for seropositive patients.
- **Twin Modular Operation Theatres**: Laminar airflow, HEPA filtration, C-arm fluoroscopy, harmonic scalpel, and advanced anesthesia workstations.
- **In-House Pathology Laboratory**: Automated hematology, biochemistry, ABG (Arterial Blood Gas), electrolytes, and cardiac biomarker testing.
- **In-House Pharmacy**: Open 24 hours for emergency and inpatient medications.
- **Patient Rooms**: Air-conditioned deluxe private suites and semi-private twin sharing rooms.

## Verified Yearly Milestones
- **Critical Patients Treated in ICU**: 2,000+
- **Outpatient (OPD) Consultations**: 5,000+
- **Complicated Surgeries & Interventions**: 70+
